plan.title: Anti-PD-1 vs isotype: mouse TME deconvolution
plan.analytical_narrative: The question asks for the immune and stromal cell composition of each of 12 mouse subcutaneous tumors (6 anti-PD-1 vs 6 isotype) and whether composition differs between treatments. Because the data are mouse bulk RNA-seq counts, human deconvolution methods (MCP-counter, xCell, EPIC, quanTIseq) are prohibited (rule R-0136); the mouse tool of record, mMCP-counter, IS installed in the environment (mMCPcounter 1.1.0), so the deconvolution runs on mMCP-counter with mouse markers. This is complemented by rank-based UCell signature scores from mouse immune/stromal marker sets as a descriptive second view. Per-sample composition scores are then compared anti-PD-1 vs isotype with a linear model (limma/t-test) with BH adjustment across cell types. Sample structure QC runs first because sample_01 has a library size ~4x below median — it is kept and inspected, not silently dropped (R-0008).
